verdict.rationale: A SaaS billing platform with SDKs and an engagement product could plausibly offer telemetry or usage-tracking opt-outs, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents any such opt-out. Mentions of 'usage tracked' refer to usage-based billing of the merchant's customers, which is a different feature and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
